author: Lenny3642
quote: The game runs at 30 fps, and it’s not even stable - even on the PS5 Pro; it’s a disgrace in 2026. On top of that, I’ve encountered bugs - which is pretty hard to swallow for a game that was in development for 13 years. And there isn’t even any Doja Cat music! It doesn’t revolutionize anything, and I’ll never understand why it got a 99. I’m not a Nintendo fanboy, but the *Ocarina of Time* remake will be my game of the year.
